description: Deletes a workbook from this account's list. It leaves every listing, search and folder, and stops counting toward them. Its versions and files are kept, and restore_workbook brings it back as it was. Keep the id this answers with: a deleted workbook is not listed anywhere, so the id is how to restore it. A workbook with a run going is refused until the run ends.
name: delete_workbook
title: Delete a workbook
